review_method: Compared both CASE records against the current Home For All project page and Shelter construction record.
Matched project name, Rikuzentakata location, 30.18 square metre footprint, 29.96 square metre floor area, two-storey wood structure and the same four design practices.
Kept the 2012 completion and recorded dismantling in 2016 and reconstruction near Rikuzentakata Station in 2022 as canonical history rather than a second building.
Reconfirmed that prior Commons and Openverse candidates show the Venice Biennale exhibition or models rather than the completed building.
Treated official project photography as identity evidence only because no open reuse license is stated.

canonical_building.name_ja: 陸前高田のみんなの家
canonical_building.history_note: Completed in November 2012, dismantled in 2016 for land-raising works, and reconstructed near Rikuzentakata Station in 2022 using retained salt-damaged cedar columns.

decisions.reason: Identity is confirmed, but no exact open-license photograph of the completed or reconstructed building is available. Exhibition and model images are not acceptable covers.
This is the same built project as CASE-037 with a separate graduation analysis. It must reuse one canonical building after a safe image is found.
